project.designConcept:
Find your next coastal look, share your style moments, and join conversations around the outfits and trends you love.
SuliJoy is a social space for beach fashion, resort style, travel inspiration, and everyday outfit creativity. Explore island-inspired looks, discover new style ideas, join live sessions, enter themed outfit challenges, and connect with people who enjoy the same fashion vibes.
Discover styles from around the world, share your own creations, and turn everyday outfits into moments worth sharing.
EXPLORE COASTAL STYLE
Browse beachwear, resort outfits, tropical prints, vacation looks, travel accessories, seasonal colors, and creative styling ideas from the community.
Find inspiration for your next trip, save ideas you like, and discover different ways people express their personal style.
OUTFIT CHALLENGES
Join themed style challenges and create looks around different concepts, colors, seasons, and occasions.
Share your outfit ideas, participate in community activities, explore other entries, and see how different people interpret the same theme in their own way.
LIVE & VOICE ROOMS
Watch live fashion sessions, join style discussions, and interact with creators and community members in real time.
Step into topic-based Voice Rooms to talk about travel, fashion trends, styling ideas, shopping finds, and everyday inspiration. Listen, share your thoughts, and join conversations that match your interests.
SHARE YOUR STYLE
Post photos, videos, text updates, and voice moments to show your latest looks, travel memories, or fashion discoveries.
Follow people whose style interests you, explore their posts and activities, and build connections through shared interests.
Direct messaging and video conversations are available after mutual connection.
OPTIONAL COIN PURCHASES
Coin packs are available as one-time consumable in-app purchases.
Coins can be used for selected digital style activities and optional AI style suggestions. The required amount of Coins is clearly displayed before confirmation.
Coin packs do not renew automatically. Package details and localized prices are shown before purchase.
SAFETY & COMMUNITY
SuliJoy is designed for adults who enjoy fashion, creativity, and social sharing.
Live sessions, Voice Rooms, and community activities are connected to visible topics and style interests. Users can report inappropriate content and block accounts at any time.
SuliJoy does not provide anonymous or random chat.
